items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: I think Sidney Catlett was playing drums with me at first, when we first went in there.

ctx.x: I wasn't making it with the teacher.
Then I took drum lessons for a while with Mr. Catlett. He was the best drummer around there as far as band drumming was concerned, you know.
Catlett. He wasn't related to Sid, was he?
